projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.humungo: A Vaxasaurian: a giant dinosaur brawler, half again your size, armour 10 and hard to knock back. Haymakers and uppercuts, a ground-pound shockwave, a tail sweep, a stampede and a quaking leap, thrown boulders and thrown creatures, a roar -- and he can grow bigger still (V): x2.2 and x3.0, more damage, armour and reach but slower. His ultimate is a leaping slam that shakes the whole area.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.humungousaur.r: Giant brawler: raw strength, shockwaves -- and he grows bigger on demand.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.humungousaur.p: Vaxasaurian Hide: armour 10, 60% knockback resistance, falls of up to 9 blocks shrugged off.
Size-Shift (V / Shift+V): x1.5 -> x2.2 -> x3.0; each step +20% move damage, more armour, reach and knockback resistance. At full size he grows bone spikes and a tail club.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.humungousaur.w: Big and slow: x0.85 speed, slower still with every size step.
A huge target: at full size he is too big for doors and tunnels.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.haymak: A huge punch at the creature in front of you: 8 damage and knocked away.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.upperc: Launch the creature in front of you skyward: 14 damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.ground: Both fists into the ground: a shockwave ring, 15 damage in 4.5 blocks (+1.5 a size step), thrown up.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.tail_s: A full spin of your tail: 12 damage in 3.5 blocks (+1 a size step), swept aside.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.stampe: Charge ahead for 1 s, ramming everything in the way: 12 damage and bowled over.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.dino_l: A great bound up and forward; the landing shakes the ground: 10 damage in 4 blocks. No fall damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.boulde: Tear up a chunk of the ground and hurl it: 17 damage, and a 2.5-block burst of 8.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.grab_a: Seize the creature in front of you (not a boss) and throw it where you look: 12 damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.grow.d: Grow one size step: x1.5 -> x2.2 -> x3.0. Each step: +20% move damage, +3 armour, more reach and knockback resistance, a little slower.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.primal: A roar in a 10-block cone (+2 a size step): 12 damage, weakened for 5 s and slowed for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.humungousaur.titani: ULTIMATE: leap high and crash down -- 55 damage at the centre, 40 at the 8-block edge (+2 blocks and +10% a size step).
message.projecthero.omnitrix.humungousau: Already at full size -- Shift+V to shrink.
